title: 第九章 不该流血又流泪第十章 不速之客
content_zh:
“王爷饶命！”李红艳颤声叫道，她比谁都清楚，今日镇北王就算是杀了她，李家也不敢放个屁。
她是真的怕了，早知道如此，给她一百个胆子，也不敢针对萧凉的。
“对待救命恩人遗孤尚且如此，你说本王如何饶你，如何饶了苏继？”
姬临风厉声叱问。
李红艳脑袋瓜子嗡嗡作响，一时间回不过神来。
苏清绾却是继续说道：“换人替嫁就算了，更过分的是，这宁国公的儿子看上了小女子，给出了丰厚的聘礼，李红艳竟然打算再次悔婚，要将我嫁给宁国公的儿子。”
“而且适才王爷没有看到，他们竟然打算要借陈君浩的手杀了萧凉，以绝后患。”
“王爷，苏家如此不仁不义，实在是辜负了萧帅当年舍命相救的大恩情，这些年来，可以想象萧凉在苏家过的是什么日子。”
苏清绾不嫌事大，故意拱火。
但她说的都是事实，瘫倒在地上的李红艳，脑袋瓜子嗡嗡作响，两眼空洞无神，充满了恐惧。
“苏继！”姬临风猛地起身，声音如雷霆炸响，不要说是苏家，半条街上，都可以听到那道威严的声音。
苏继并不知道厅堂这边发生了什么，此时他还在自己的练功房里面修炼。
听出来是姬临风的声音，他睁开眼睛猛地起身，以极快的速度赶到厅堂这边，看到满脸怒意的镇北王，苏继心神猛地一颤，直接跪在地上，“见过王爷，王爷息怒，不知道您驾临有何吩咐？”
曾经他是姬临风的部下，见过姬临风在战场上勇猛杀敌的模样，他知道这个年轻的大熙亲王是何等恐怖的存在。
当年在军中，姬临风对萧野就是极为尊敬和崇拜的，遇上大小事情，在做决定之前，必定会与萧野探讨一番。
只是这些年来，姬临风一直在边关，对萧野的遗孤萧凉也没有多少关心，是以苏继以为姬临风不再关注萧家的一切。
可谁曾想到，因为萧凉被退婚，今日姬临风竟然亲自登门。
眼下这般情况，还有谁能救苏家？
苏继跪在地上，神色苍白到极致，他后悔让苏清绾替嫁了。
可是苏雨涵是极品灵根，而萧凉只是下品灵根，要因为他的一句承诺，毁了苏雨涵的前途，毁了苏家吗？

苏继此时还是觉得他所做一切没有什么不妥之处，只是出现了姬临风这个插曲。
“苏继，你的命是萧帅的，可是你就这般照顾他的遗孤的？”姬临风厉声喝道。
“王爷恕罪！”苏继跪在地上，眼中充满了惊恐之色。
陈君浩此时却是成了最尴尬的一个，若是可以，他希望自己生一双翅膀，立刻飞离此间。
本以为萧凉着蝼蚁好欺负，谁曾想到却是牵扯出来镇北王。
而且镇北王一直在北方边关，看这模样，应该是刚刚进京，便往苏家赶来了。
若是如此的话，恐怕苏家宅院外面，少说也有上百的镇北军吧。
想到这里，陈君浩脸色刷的一白。
“若不是看在萧副帅的面上，今日本王就一剑斩了你！”姬临风看着苏继，满眼恨铁不成钢。
闻言，苏继却是松了口气，他知道姬临风没有杀他的意思，自己的小命算是保住了。
content_en:
"Your Majesty, spare your life!" Li Hongyan shouted tremblingly. She knew better than anyone else that even if the King of Zhenbei killed her today, the Li family would not dare to fart.
She was really scared. If she had known this, she would not have dared to target Xiao Liang if she had been given a hundred courages.
"If you treat the orphan of your savior like this, how can I spare you and Su Ji?"
Ji Linfeng asked sharply.
Li Hongyan's head was buzzing, and she couldn't recover for a while.
Su Qingwan continued, "It's okay to replace her with someone else. What's even more outrageous is that Ning Guogong's son fell in love with the little girl and gave a generous bride price. Li Hongyan actually planned to regret the marriage again and marry me to Ning Guogong's son."
"And Prince Shicai didn't see it. They actually planned to use Chen Junhao's hand to kill Xiao Liang to avoid future troubles."
"My lord, the Su family is so unkind and unjust. They have really let down the great kindness of Xiao Shuai who risked his life to save him. Over the years, you can imagine what kind of life Xiao Liang has been living in the Su family."
Su Qingwan didn't think it was a big deal and deliberately made things worse.
But what she said was true. Li Hongyan collapsed on the ground, her head buzzing, her eyes blank and full of fear.
"Su Ji!" Ji Linfeng stood up suddenly, his voice like thunder. Not to mention the Su family, that majestic voice could be heard in half the street.
Su Ji didn't know what was happening in the hall. At this time, he was still practicing in his practice room.
Hearing that it was Ji Linfeng's voice, he opened his eyes and stood up suddenly, rushing to the hall at a very fast speed. Seeing the angry Zhenbei King, Su Ji's heart trembled suddenly and he knelt down directly on the ground, "I have seen the prince, please calm down. What are your orders when you come?"
He used to be Ji Linfeng's subordinate, and had seen Ji Linfeng bravely killing enemies on the battlefield. He knew how terrifying this young Prince Daxi was.
When he was in the army, Ji Linfeng had great respect and admiration for Xiao Ye. Whenever he encountered any big or small matter, he would definitely discuss it with Xiao Ye before making a decision.
It's just that Ji Linfeng has been at the border these years and doesn't care much about Xiao Ye's orphan Xiao Liang. So Su Ji thought that Ji Linfeng no longer paid attention to everything about the Xiao family.
But who would have thought that because Xiao Liang's engagement was annulled, Ji Linfeng would come to visit in person today.
In this current situation, who else can save the Su family?
Su Ji knelt on the ground, looking extremely pale. He regretted letting Su Qingwan marry him instead.
But Su Yuhan has a top-grade spiritual root, while Xiao Liang is only a low-grade spiritual root. Will Su Yuhan's future and the Su family be ruined just because of his promise?
At this time, Su Ji still felt that there was nothing wrong with everything he did, except for the episode of Ji Linfeng.
"Su Ji, your life belongs to Xiao Shuai, but you take care of his orphan like this?" Ji Linfeng shouted sharply.
"My lord, forgive me!" Su Ji knelt on the ground, his eyes filled with horror.
Chen Junhao has become the most embarrassed one at this time. If possible, he hopes to grow a pair of wings and fly away from here immediately.
I thought that Xiao Liang was easy to bully, but who would have thought that he would involve King Zhenbei.
Moreover, King Zhenbei has been at the northern border. Judging from his appearance, he must have just arrived in Beijing and rushed to the Su family.
If this is the case, I'm afraid there may be at least hundreds of Zhenbei troops outside the Su family's residence.
Thinking of this, Chen Junhao's face turned pale.
"If it weren't for Deputy Marshal Xiao's sake, I would have killed you with one sword today!" Ji Linfeng looked at Su Ji, filled with hatred that iron cannot be transformed into steel.
Hearing this, Su Ji breathed a sigh of relief. He knew that Ji Linfeng had no intention of killing him, and his life was saved.
